remarks: RARE OPPORTUNITY to own in Westport with income to support your family. This multi-family home is just across the street from scenic Saugatuck River and convenient to Westport center. Remodeled features include updated kitchens, bathrooms, windows, mechanicals & more. UNIT #1 is on 1st floor: Living Rm, Eat-in Kitchen, 2 Bedrooms, Full Bathroom with laundry, Screened Porch. UNIT #2: 2nd floor: Living rm, Eat-in Kitchen, 1 Bedroom, 1 Bathroom, Enclosed porch. Unit 2 continues on 3rd floor with 2 Bedrooms and 1 Bathroom. Level useable rear yard. Ample Parking. Full basement storage and additional laundry facility. In-Town location assures you full occupancy. Current use is legal 2 family, however, past field card notes property as having 3 units.
